title: Spreading and dilution of the Gulf outflow water in the Arabian Sea
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020 in the western and northern Arabian Sea (47-70 E, 4-26 N), determine how the high-salinity water that leaves the Gulf of Oman at about 200-350 m (Persian Gulf Water) spreads and is diluted in the Arabian Sea: along which paths, how fast, in which seasons, and by which processes.
